description: This file generates a webhook payload for reporting end-to-end test results of Mattermost's Playwright tests, including dynamic title generation based on environment variables and test summary data.

methods.name: generateTitle
methods.description: Creates a dynamic title string for the webhook message based on environment variables and build type.

methods.name: generateWebhookBody
methods.description: Constructs the webhook payload with test results, environment info, and build details.
